appDescription: A driving diary app for new drivers that records each drive from vehicle signals, writes a diary entry after parking, and keeps routes shared by family members for practice.

function.name: READ_LATEST_DIARY
function.description: Returns the most recent driving diary entry written from the driver's last drive.

function.name: GET_NEXT_ROUTE
function.description: Returns the next practice route shared by a family member, including the advice left on that route.

function.name: CHECK_DRIVING_PROGRESS
function.description: Returns how the driver's recent drives changed compared with earlier drives, such as the number of parking maneuvers.
